exposure: previous CS outcome and associated factors
reasons to decline a repeat CS (postoperative pain, 'failure of womanhood' tag)
cohort: The study included 157 consecutive consenting antenatal clinic clients with a history of previous cesarean section who were presenting for booking in Central Hospital, Agbor, Delta State, Nigeria.
finding: The acceptance rate of repeat cesarean section was 54%, with women having two or more previous CS being significantly more likely to accept it compared to those with fewer.
mod_finding: The acceptance rate of repeat cesarean section was 54%, and rejection was primarily attributed to concerns about postoperative pain and the social stigma of 'failure of womanhood'.
